label_factory_metadata.demotion_rule: silver/gold labels demote to bronze, or bronze labels stay review-only, when retrieval counterevidence, abstention, top-family mismatch, or out-of-scope false non-abstention is present
label_factory_metadata.promotion_rule: bronze labels promote to silver when retrieval agrees with the label, the score clears the abstention threshold, and no evidence-limiting cofactor or counterevidence conflict is present

policy.pass_rule: ready_for_geometry_confirmation_run AND local geometry status ok AND label_factory recommended_action == promote_to_silver

counterevidence_categories.mechanism_text_review_context_counterevi: Curated review-context counterevidence from mechanism text; review/abstention only and not valid external/orphan safety evidence.
counterevidence_categories.structure_local_evidence_counterevidence: Predictive safety counterevidence from active-site residues, local ligands, pocket descriptors, or compactness.

leakage_policy.review_context_policy: Mechanism text, entry names, labels, EC/Rhea identifiers, and source ids may be carried for review, abstention, or counterevidence provenance, but must not add positive retrieval score.

retrieval_metadata.scoring: residue and role overlap plus ligand/cofactor context, local PLP ligand-anchor context, substrate-pocket descriptors, and compactness
retrieval_metadata.validation_boundary: retrieval evidence only; not mechanism validation
